assets.icons: Use lucide-react for all icons (ShieldCheck, Star, Truck, Clock, ChevronRight, etc.)

implementation_plan.step_1: Setup Fonts & Global Styles: Add Google Fonts import to index.css. Define CSS variables for colors.
implementation_plan.step_2: Create Layout Component: 'FunnelLayout' that handles the 3-step state (currentStep, formData, orderDetails).
implementation_plan.step_3: Build Page 1 (Product): Hero section with image carousel, '40% OFF' badge, Benefits grid, Testimonials, Sticky 'Buy Now' button.
implementation_plan.step_4: Build Page 2 (Details): Form for Name, Address, Phone (Mandatory). Show 'Unlock Extra ₹300 OFF with Prepaid' banner.
implementation_plan.step_5: Build Page 3 (Payment): Toggle between COD (₹1199) and Prepaid (₹899). Show delivery timeline (5-7 days vs Fast). Order Summary.
implementation_plan.step_6: Build Success View: Order confirmation with random Order ID.
implementation_plan.step_7: Add Micro-interactions: Smooth transitions between steps, button press effects, confetti on success.

universal_guidelines: Mobile-First: Design strictly for mobile width (max-w-md mx-auto).
High Contrast: Ensure text is readable against backgrounds.
Touch Targets: Buttons must be at least 44px height.
Speed: Optimize image loading (lazy load gallery).
Trust: Always show 'Secure Checkout' or 'Verified' badges near payment.
No Dead Ends: Every page must have a clear primary action.
Data-TestID: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
